# Katya — React UX/UI proof

> An independent one-page proof of visual craft in React, clearer product flow, and structured LLM context.

## Status

- Private prototype; not intended for search indexing.
- Inspired by observations of UNKNW's public website.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced for UNKNW.

## Content rules

- Catalogue, project names, dates, and statuses are synthetic demonstration content.
- No UNKNW logos, case-study images, client assets, or private data are included.
- Form state stays in the current tab. There is no external API, AI call, analytics, database, authentication, or submission endpoint.

## User paths

1. Compare the visual rhythm and motion with the public reference; the covers themselves are original fictional graphics.
2. Filter the synthetic catalogue by service, industry, and outcome.
3. Complete the brief intake to produce readable text and structured JSON.
4. Copy LLM context, or manually select its visible text if clipboard access is unavailable.
